reference_sql:
WITH order_rev AS (
  -- one row per order
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, s.order_date, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, s.order_date
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date,
  SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_revenue_eur
FROM order_rev

  JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100

    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'

)
SELECT r.customer_id, r.order_id, r.order_date,
  (SELECT SUM(r2.revenue_eur) FROM order_rev r2 WHERE r2.customer_id = r.customer_id AND r2.order_date <= r.order_date) AS running_revenue_eur
FROM order_rev r

WITH order_rev AS (
  -- one row per order
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, s.order_date, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, s.order_date
), by_day AS (
  -- one row per customer and day with orders
  SELECT customer_id, order_date,
    SUM(SUM(revenue_eur)) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_revenue_eur
  FROM order_rev
  GROUP BY customer_id, order_date
)
SELECT r.customer_id, r.order_id, r.order_date, d.running_revenue_eur
FROM order_rev r
JOIN by_day d ON d.customer_id = r.customer_id AND d.order_date = r.order_date

solver.query:
WITH order_rev AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY order_id
),
cust_orders AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         o.order_id,
         CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS order_date,
         r.order_revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_rev r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) <= DATE '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT customer_id,
       order_id,
       order_date,
       SUM(order_revenue_eur) OVER (
         PARTITION BY customer_id
         ORDER BY order_date
         RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS running_revenue_eur
FROM cust_orders
